blurb: The Angler Fleet is a family-friendly business located in Port Washington, New York. We specialize in private charters and open boat fishing including our most popular half day fishing trips, kids summer camp, and summer fireworks cruises. Join us on the calm, sheltered waters of Long Island Sound for a memorable fishing trip to catch fluke, blackfish, striped bass, or scup (porgy).
